Vietnam.description: Sovereign active fire regime across Central Highlands, Northwest montane, and southern agricultural ecosystems.

Indonesia.description: Peat dome burning and tropical agricultural expansion across Sumatra, Kalimantan, and Papua.

Australia.description: Savanna burning across Northern Territory & Kimberley, and temperate bushfires in southeastern New South Wales and Victoria.

Brazil.description: Amazon deforestation fire corridor and agricultural savanna burning in the Cerrado and Pantanal wetlands.

Canada.description: Subarctic and boreal forest crown fires in British Columbia, Alberta, Quebec, and Northwest Territories.

United States.description: Western mega-fires in California and Pacific Northwest, plus spring agricultural burning in the Southeast.

Democratic Republic of the Congo.description: Intense slash-and-burn agricultural clearing and Miombo savanna burning in the southern Congo Basin.

Global (Worldwide).peak_season: Aug – Oct (Southern Hemisphere Savannas & Boreal Summer)
Global (Worldwide).description: Worldwide total active fire events aggregated across all continents.

South America (Amazon & Cerrado).description: Amazon basin deforestation fires and Cerrado biome savannah burning.

Central & Southern Africa.description: Agricultural stubble, pasture management, and Miombo woodland burning.

Australia & Oceania.description: Northern Territory savannah burning and catastrophic Black Summer bushfires (2019-2020).

North America (Western US & Canada).description: California wildfires, Pacific Northwest, and historic 2023 Canadian boreal blazes.

Southeast Asia & Indochina.description: Agricultural clearing, peatland fires, and seasonal deciduous forest burning.

Europe & Mediterranean.description: Southern Europe summer heatwave fires in Greece, Spain, Portugal, and Italy.
